author: XtraMajestical
body:
I feel like this was never announced or advertised properly, as I only found this out last week, there I thought I would make a forum post as to how!
You will need a Emerald / diamond rank in order to do this aswell.
1) Go to the hub and click on the gadgets icon. 

2) Now click the map icon called "Game Modifications"

3) Now to finish you will see two options -"Next map selector", and then "Start map vote"! Now you can use this whenever!
